newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK ONE-DAY REPO RATE UP TO 17.50 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK ONE-DAY REPO RATE UP TO 17.50 PCT.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Tuesday said the average and only rate at its one-day securities repurchase tender was 17.50 percent, up from 16.55 percent on Monday.
The NBS added that it had allocated funds totalling 1.6 billion crowns, the full fixed amount it had offered, through the tender.
The NBS said it had received 3.09 billion crowns worth of bids.

According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 91.53 percent as of Monday, after being in a liquidity surplus at 102.2 percent as of Friday. -- Bratislava Newsroom, 421-7-521-8402
